title: STIB-MIVB stops: wheelchair accessibility
description: Metro, tram and bus stops of STIB-MIVB in Brussels with the GTFS wheelchair_boarding value per stop: accessible (about 1,700), not_accessible (about 700) or unknown. From the static GTFS feed on data.belgianmobility.io, refreshed daily. Search by stop name or near a point.
access_note: Open data; reuse must cite 'Source: <operator> – Open Data – <date of dataset update>' (given in each response's provenance).

assessment.note: Stop accessibility (wheelchair_boarding) as published by the operator in its GTFS feed; 0 means no information.
